summary: Iteration 149: Client 360° Full Profile - All features tested and working. Backend: 27/27 tests passed. Frontend: All new tabs (Subscriptions, Security) and enhanced tabs (Assets, Billing) verified with data loading correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: ClientsPage.jsx is 1100+ lines - consider splitting into smaller components
Client360Tabs.jsx is well-structured with reusable components (Stat, InfoTile, EmptyState)
seed_data_creation: Used existing client-001 (Acme Corporation) with 4 subscriptions, 10 devices, $18k AR
context_for_next_testing_agent: Client 360° features fully working: 1) 5 new backend endpoints (full-profile, subscriptions, security, billing-detail, assets-detail) all return expected data, 2) 12 tabs visible on client detail (overview/tickets/assets/subscriptions/security/contacts/billing/blueprints/ai/integrations/cipp/activity), 3) Subscriptions tab shows 4 MSP Contract items totaling $13,895/mo, 4) Security tab shows MFA/CIPP/Huntress stats with deep-links, 5) Assets tab shows 10 devices in 10 model families with online/offline counts, 6) Billing tab shows AR aging buckets + recent invoices table, 7) Help article 'clients-360' accessible at /help/clients-360

full_profile.notes: Returns client + subscriptions + security + billing + assets + tickets + integrations + churn + dna + last_sentiment

subscriptions.notes: Returns items[] with source/source_label/product/quantity/unit_price/monthly_cost/billing_cycle/status, count, total_monthly_aud, total_seats

security.notes: Returns mfa_pct, cipp_hygiene, cipp_dimensions, huntress_agents, huntress_critical, user_count, stale_users, weak_passwords

billing_detail.notes: Returns open_balance, overdue_balance, aging{current,30,60,90+}, mrr_aud, ltv_aud, recent_invoices[], recurring_count, payment_promises{kept,broken}

assets_detail.notes: Returns groups[] (by model) with count/online/offline/avg_age_years/devices_preview[], total, online, offline

404_handling.notes: All 5 endpoints return 404 for invalid client_id

subscriptions_tab.notes: Shows 4 stat tiles (Active subs, Total seats, Monthly $, Annual $) + source badges + subscription table with MSP Contract items

security_tab.notes: Shows 4 stat tiles (MFA%, CIPP hygiene, Huntress agents, Critical alerts) + info tiles + deep-links to /cipp and /huntress-dashboard

assets_tab.notes: Shows 3 stat tiles (Total/Online/Offline) + device families grid with 10 model groups, each showing count/online/offline/avg age/4-device preview

billing_tab.notes: Shows 4 stat tiles (Open balance $18,189, Overdue 90+ $0, MRR $13,895, LTV $0) + AR Aging card with 4 coloured buckets + Recent invoices table (10 invoices)

help_article.title: Clients 360° — Full Profile Tabs
help_article.notes: Article accessible at /help/clients-360, documents all 12 tabs with tinker instructions
